none: PAS BH-643FB1: Roman box flue tile (fragment)
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

An irregular fragment of a Roman box flue tile. The piece is of flat section and orange-brown in colour. The outer surface is decorated by a roller-printed pattern in which two areas of chevrons border a band that contains what appear to be the letters 'IX', with the 'X' being incomplete.
